app.title: ToME mechanics reference test harness
app.subtitle: Reference tests for selected scalar mechanics · Tales of Maj'Eyal 1.7.6
app.warning: This is a reference test harness. The full game does not run yet.
app.scope: The original C/Lua gameplay source is preserved. Rust calculations here characterize selected accuracy, damage, speed, resistance, energy and random-number behavior for comparison; they are not the production gameplay core.
app.limitations: The original C/Lua gameplay core is not connected to this browser screen yet. Maps, actors, talents, classes, inventory, quests, campaign progression, graphics and sound cannot be played here.
app.coverage: These catalogs cover the reference test harness. Text-ID integration and Japanese translation of the original C/Lua game are still pending.
app.license: Source-derived code: GPL-3.0-or-later. This workbench includes no upstream game graphics, music or commercial add-on assets.
app.attribution: Original mechanics: Nicolas Casalini and Tales of Maj'Eyal contributors. Rust reference tests and display adapters: jrogue contributors.
ui.title: ToME mechanics reference test harness
ui.subtitle: This is a reference test harness. The original C/Lua gameplay core is not connected yet.
ui.name: Player name
ui.help: Use buttons, Space or Enter to sample an attack; use . to advance one tick. Keyboard shortcuts stay inactive during text entry, IME composition, key repeat or modifier shortcuts. An attack requires 1,000 action energy.
ui.loaded: Save restored. The random sequence resumes from the saved state.
ui.loading: Loading the Rust mechanics reference tests…
ui.name_help: Names are user-provided text and are never translated. Use 1–80 characters without control characters.
ui.seed_help: Use an integer from 0 through 4,294,967,295. Restart uses default parameters and preserves the player name.
ui.save_help: A test-harness save includes version, ruleset, parameters, counters, events and random-generator state. It is not a game save. Language is a separate display setting.
ui.parameter_help: These controls characterize a bounded subset of original formulas for comparison. Production gameplay remains in the original C/Lua core; an attack test does not implement the full weapon-attack pipeline.
ui.event_help: The latest 100 semantic events are retained. Changing the display language retranslates history without advancing the simulation.
ui.formula_note: Hit chance uses the 0–100 bounds with tutorial mode off. Combat speed uses no added speed; resistance uses a force factor of 1.
